title: Obtain all number moments from a graded analytic eigenprojection
statement: Let H0 preserve nonnegative integer grading N,V change it by at most one,and psi(g)=P(g)psi0 be a nonzero analytic Riesz vector from a bare grading-zero simple eigenstate. Every polynomial N moment is finite; normalize by ||psi(g)|| when needed.
